name: APU_7_Notifications_and_Alerts
title: APU.7 Notifications and Alerts (Function)
description:
This category applies only if an app exchanges data with other devices, health apps, and/or HIT systems. If so, there are applicable
 standards for data format, vocabulary, and transport, to increase interoperability and ease of connection.

statement.label: APU.7#01
statement.requirement: The system SHALL require opt-in consent from the account holder before sending notifications and alerts.

statement.label: APU.7#02
statement.requirement: The system SHALL inform the account holder of both the content and the channel, such as SMS, push notification, or email, of the notification or alert that is consented to.

statement.label: APU.7#03
statement.requirement: IF an alert, notification, or message is generated or prioritized by AI THEN the system SHALL identify the message as AI-generated or AI-prioritized when that information is material to the user's interpretation or action.

statement.label: APU.7#04
statement.requirement: The system SHALL provide the account holder with the ability to change consent decisions about notifications and alerts through settings available on the device on which the system was downloaded.

statement.label: APU.7#05
statement.requirement: The system SHALL provide notifications and alerts that contain the least amount of information necessary for the recipient to take a focused action.

statement.label: APU.7#06
statement.requirement: IF alerts notify the user of conditions that are abnormal, exceptional, or determined to be out of range THEN the system SHALL document or reference the sources (evidence base) of the formulas and algorithms on which those alerts and notifications are based.

statement.label: APU.7#07
statement.requirement: IF an AI-generated alert advises a health or safety action THEN the system SHALL ensure that the alert's triggering logic, evidence basis, validation scope, and safe escalation instructions are documented and appropriate to the system's intended use.

statement.label: APU.7#08
statement.requirement: IF permitted by the account holder and agreed to by the recipients THEN the system SHOULD provide the ability to send notifications and alerts to the account holder and to another person or entity.

statement.label: APU.7#09
statement.requirement: The system SHOULD provide alerts that notify the user of potential faults that could cause inconvenience or harm, such as low battery alerts.

statement.label: APU.7#10
statement.requirement: The system SHOULD notify the user in the case of external interruptions or delays, such as loss of network connection, a database problem, or a lengthy operation.

statement.label: APU.7#11
statement.requirement: IF the system can detect AI uncertainty, out-of-distribution input, or unavailable supporting data THEN the system SHOULD suppress, downgrade, or qualify the AI-generated alert when the risk assessment indicates that the underlying output may be unreliable.

statement.label: APU.7#12
statement.requirement: IF the system uses AI to personalize notification timing or content THEN the system MAY allow the account holder to control the personalization settings and the categories of data used for personalization.
